notes.title: Released
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello friends, greetings to you all.[/b]
First of all, thank you so much for the wonderful reception that [b]Bombardiro Crocodilo Mission[/b] has been receiving it truly fills us with joy.[/p][p]We’d like to share that we worked on this project for many months, and we’re very happy that the launch is finally live. We sincerely hope you enjoy it.[/p][previewyoutube="NKXMwhS7y6I;full"][/previewyoutube][p]We are completely open to any comments or feedback you’d like to share. You can let us know in the community hub, in this post, or through our different channels. If you find any bug or issue, or simply want to leave your opinion, it will be more than welcome.[/p][p]We would also greatly appreciate it if you could leave a positive review if you enjoyed the game. We will continue working hard to improve the experience in every way that you, our beloved community, consider necessary.[/p][p]We hope you enjoy [b]BCM[/b] join Bombardiro Crocodilo and his Brainrot friends to rescue [b]Ballerina Cappuchina[/b], and above all, thank you so much![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647976/4dbd1e13b9d02629deedcde3855404337622440f.png"][/img][/p][p]Warm regards,
[b]TEAM Black Hat Robot[/b][/p][p][url="https://www.teamblackhatrobot.com/" style="button" buttoncolor="#42b832"]Webpage[/url][/p]
